description: The project owner's property/landlord questions, copied VERBATIM from chat on 2026-11-08, BEFORE property law was added to NyayaAI. Do not edit.
author: project owner
questions: I've rented a commercial shop in Bengaluru under a written lease for five years. After just one year, the landlord sent me a notice asking me to leave, even though I haven't violated any terms. Can he terminate my lease before the agreed period?

I paid the full amount for a property in Kolkata and signed an agreement with the seller. Now the seller is refusing to complete the sale and says he wants to sell the property to somebody else for a higher price. What legal options do I have?

I rented a flat in Mumbai for three years, but my landlord and I only signed a normal agreement on stamp paper. We never registered it. Is this agreement legally valid, and can either of us rely on it in court?

I'm living in a rented house in Delhi. My landlord suddenly told me to leave within three days because he wants to rent the property to someone else at a higher price. Can he force me to vacate like this?

I rented a flat in Delhi and paid my landlord ₹50,000 as a security deposit. I've vacated the flat, cleared all my bills and returned the keys, but he keeps making excuses and isn't returning my deposit. What can I legally do?
